{{Ship module infobox}}

The '''Sub-surface Extraction Missile''' is a fixed hardpoint developed for rescuing human captives from Thargoid Titans. Aegis adapted the drilling mechanism of the [[Sub-surface Displacement Missile]] using blueprints supplied by Sirius Corporation. Instead of extracting minerals from asteroids, its missiles penetrated Titan storage chambers and released the bio-storage capsules held inside.<ref name="manufacture">[https://www.elitedangerous.com/news/galnet/deliver-resources-extraction-missile-manufacture ''Deliver Resources for Extraction Missile Manufacture''], Frontier Developments, 28 September 3309.</ref>

Frontier continues to identify the launcher as equipment dedicated to Titan gameplay rather than mining.<ref name="dodec">[https://www.elitedangerous.com/news/updates/4-2-2-0 ''Elite Dangerous: Dodec Update''], Frontier Developments, 11 November 2025.</ref>

== Specifications ==

Current Live module data records one class 2B fixed version.<ref name="edsy-extraction">EDSY, [https://github.com/taleden/EDSY/blob/9cd829062217036184ea9ec79ee30934d235aca8/eddb.js#L2867 commit-pinned Sub-surface Extraction Missile record], accessed 20 September 2026.</ref>

{| class="wikitable" style="width:100%;"
! Class and rating !! Mount !! Mass !! Integrity !! Power draw !! Magazine / reserve !! Reload !! Projectile speed !! Reference price
|-
| 2B || Fixed || 4.00 t || 50 || 1.00 MW || 1 / 96 || 2 seconds || 550 m/s || 843,170 CR
|}

EDSY records a nominal cyclic rate of 0.5 missiles per second, equivalent to a two-second launch interval. Actual extraction attempts take longer because the pilot must hold the trigger through the drilling phase and time the detonation.

== Operation ==

The launcher was used with a Pulse Wave Xeno Scanner, which identified human life signs and targetable storage chambers beneath a Titan's hull. With a chamber targeted in Analysis Mode, the pilot fired while continuing to hold the trigger. The drilling display then showed the missile's depth and a blue extraction zone. Releasing the trigger while the marker crossed that zone detonated the charge and ejected the stored capsules.<ref name="aegis-production">[https://www.elitedangerous.com/news/galnet/aegis-produces-sub-surface-extraction-missiles ''Aegis Produces Sub-Surface Extraction Missiles''], Frontier Developments, 5 October 3309.</ref><ref name="community-operation">[https://elite-dangerous.fandom.com/wiki/Sub-surface_Extraction_Missile ''Sub-surface Extraction Missile''], Elite Dangerous Wiki, accessed 20 September 2026.</ref>

Released capsules could be recovered with the cargo scoop or [[Collector Limpet Controller|collector limpets]]. During the Titan war, pilots delivered them to a Search and Rescue contact for quarantine and revival attempts.<ref name="aegis-production" />

== Module boundary ==

Despite its origin, the Sub-surface Extraction Missile is not asteroid-mining equipment. It does not work on ordinary sub-surface mineral deposits, and Frontier deliberately excludes it from the Type-11 Prospector's mining-only hardpoints. Asteroid deposits require the [[Sub-surface Displacement Missile]].<ref name="dodec" />

The extraction missile is also distinct from the other equipment used to reach and operate around a Titan. A Pulse Wave Xeno Scanner found storage chambers; a Thargoid Pulse Neutraliser countered the Maelstrom's repulsion wave; [[Caustic Sink Launcher|Caustic Sink Launchers]] managed corrosive exposure; and the extraction missile performed the actual breach.

== Acquisition ==

Aegis placed the module into credit-purchase Outfitting stock at rescue megaships on 5 October 3309, following a production initiative in Senlu.<ref name="aegis-production" /> Current station inventories can change, so commanders looking for a copy should check a current outfitting database before travelling.

The module is Live-only. It was introduced in 3309, after Frontier separated the Live and Legacy galaxies.<ref name="live-legacy">[https://www.elitedangerous.com/en-US/news/elite-dangerous-update-14-and-beyond-live-and-legacy-modes ''Elite Dangerous Update 14 and Beyond: Live and Legacy Modes''], Frontier Developments, 23 November 2022.</ref>
